verdict.rationale: Make documents native scenario scheduling: a 'schedule a scenario' help page, and webhook-triggered scenarios that can be set to process their queue periodically whenever 'schedule criteria are met'. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-expression syntax or per-schedule timezone control. Missing for 10: cron-style expression support, timezone configuration, detailed scheduling docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: you can schedule your to process all webhook requests periodically
the whole queue is then processed every time your schedule criteria are met
